## Landed · 2026-11-16T01:22Z

PR #34185 merged as `69b4ee3d` (ACCEPT 6904164867; contract review PASS 6903701953). `--lang zh|en` sends every card-authored text a prompt carries (the build prompt, the iterate change, each question's and operation's ask) in that language and no other, in scratch, template and ask modes and at every `--ask-repeats` ask; the runner's own wrapper text stays English. A card lacking a text the run would send in that language is skipped before the first card runs, naming each missing field. `--prompt short|detailed` picks the build turn's card prompt (default `detailed`). The record and scorecard state the choice when a flag set it, a recording carries it, and a replay under another choice is refused before any card runs. With neither flag every prompt, record, scorecard and recording is unchanged. A Chinese reply grades as an English one does (pinned on `leave_balances`), so no scoring change. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing. Queue ① moves to #33818, its last card.
